info.name: Wedding Invitation API
info.description:
REST API for the wedding invitation platform (website + sales dashboard).

Quick start:
1. Import this collection and the "Wedding Invitation - Local" environment, select the environment.
2. Run "Sales Dashboard > Auth > Login" (default admin from schema.sql) — the token is saved automatically.
3. Run "Website Customer > Auth > Register" (or Login) — the customer token is saved automatically.
4. Follow "Website Customer > Invitations" top to bottom: create draft → save steps → submit.
5. "Sales Dashboard > Submissions > Mark as paid", then the customer can import guests and send e-mails.

IDs (invitationId, guestId, ...) are stored in collection variables by the test scripts.
All responses: { success, message?, data, meta? }. Errors: { success:false, message, code, details?, requestId }.

request.description: Liveness + database ping. 503 when the DB is down.
Active templates for the website template gallery.

Only PAID invitations are public. `code` (from the e-mail link) personalises the page with the guest name and RSVP state. Omit it for the generic link.
Creates a guest entry from the name. Returns an inviteCode the page can keep for later changes.
Visible wishes only.
